name: bracket-maker
description: Make seeded tournament brackets, round robin schedules and Swiss pairings with byes, timetables and printable PDFs.

interface.longDescription:
Make a tournament bracket in the chat, record results by clicking the winners, and print it.

Tournament bracket maker: single elimination and double elimination brackets for 2 to 128 players or teams. Standard seeding puts seed 1 against the lowest seed, so seeds 1 and 2 can only meet in the final; when the field is not a power of two (a bracket for 6, 10 or 12 teams), the byes go to the top seeds and are placed exactly where a seeded bracket needs them. Add a third-place match, or use double elimination with a losers bracket and a grand final with an optional reset match. Seeding can follow your ranking, a reproducible random draw, or the order you list.

Round robin schedule generator: everyone plays everyone exactly once (or home and away), nobody plays twice in a round, one team sits out each round when the number is odd, and home and away games are balanced. Swiss pairings: players with the same score meet each round, with no rematches whenever they can be avoided, and a fair rotation of byes.

Timetable: give the number of courts, tables or fields, the match length and the start time to get a start time and court for every match and the finish time of the event.

Results and standings: tell it who won, or click a player in the bracket, and winners advance, the next matches appear and the champion and final places are shown. Round robin tables use points, then head-to-head, then score difference; Swiss tables use Buchholz.

Print and share: a landscape PDF bracket that stays readable up to 64 players, with an order-of-play page, and a CSV schedule for spreadsheets. For coaches, teachers, clubs, office leagues, school sports days and gaming nights.

Limitations: up to 128 participants; round robin up to 500 matches; Swiss pairing is a simplified score-group method without chess colour allocation; timetables assume equal match lengths.
defaultPrompt: Make a single elimination bracket for 6 teams: Hawks, Bears, Lions, Wolves, Eagles, Sharks
Round robin for 5 pickleball players: Ann, Ben, Cara, Dev, Eli on 2 courts, 15-minute games from 18:00
Double elimination bracket for 8 players: Ava, Ben, Cole, Dana, Eli, Fay, Gus, Hana

positive.description: Single elimination bracket with byes for a non-power-of-two field
positive.prompt: Make a single elimination bracket for 6 teams: Hawks, Bears, Lions, Wolves, Eagles, Sharks
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_tournament_bracket once with the 6 teams in the given order and format single_elimination. Result: a bracket of 8 with 2 first-round byes for seed 1 Hawks and seed 2 Bears, 5 matches in 3 rounds: quarterfinals M1 Wolves vs Eagles and M2 Lions vs Sharks, semifinals M3 Hawks vs winner of M1 and M4 Bears vs winner of M2, final M5. The widget draws the bracket with connectors; clicking Wolves records that Wolves won M1 and moves them into M3. The reply links a landscape PDF bracket and a CSV schedule.

positive.description: Round robin schedule with courts and a timetable
positive.prompt: Round robin for 5 pickleball players: Ann, Ben, Cara, Dev, Eli on 2 courts, 15-minute games from 18:00
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_tournament_bracket once with format round_robin, courts 2, match_minutes 15 and start_time 18:00. Result: 10 matches in 5 rounds, every pair meets exactly once, nobody plays twice in a round and one player sits out each round (Ann in round 1). Every match gets a start time and court; the schedule runs from 18:00 to about 19:15. The widget shows the rounds with click-to-record winners and a Table tab; the PDF lists every round with write-in score blanks.

positive.prompt: Double elimination bracket for 8 players: Ava, Ben, Cole, Dana, Eli, Fay, Gus, Hana
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_tournament_bracket once with format double_elimination. Result: a bracket of 8 with no byes and 14 matches (2n-2) plus a grand final reset only if the losers-bracket champion wins the grand final; the winners bracket has 3 rounds and the losers bracket 4 rounds. Round 1 is Ava vs Hana, Dana vs Eli, Ben vs Gus, Cole vs Fay. The widget shows the winners bracket and the losers bracket with the grand final; the PDF has bracket pages and an order-of-play page.

positive.description: Round robin standings from reported results
positive.prompt: Our 4-team round robin is Reds, Blues, Greens, Golds. Reds beat Blues 3-1, Greens and Golds drew 2-2, Reds beat Greens 2-0, Blues beat Golds 4-2. Show the table.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_bracket_standings once with format round_robin, the 4 teams and the 4 results. The table is Reds 6 pts, Blues 3 pts, then Golds and Greens on 1 pt each with Golds ahead on scores for (equal head-to-head after the draw and equal score difference). The reply names the 2 matches still to play: Golds vs Reds and Blues vs Greens.

positive.description: Swiss pairings for a club night
positive.prompt: Swiss pairings for our chess club, 4 rounds, 10 players: Alice, Bram, Chen, Dora, Emil, Faye, Gabe, Hugo, Iris, Jon
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_tournament_bracket once with format swiss and swiss_rounds 4. Round 1 pairs the top half against the bottom half: Alice vs Faye, Bram vs Gabe, Chen vs Hugo, Dora vs Iris, Emil vs Jon. The reply explains that round 2 is paired from the round 1 results (points, then seed, no rematches). Reporting results later with calculate_bracket_standings returns the table and the next round's pairings.

negative.description: Predicting who will win a real tournament is out of scope: the assistant answers in text and calls no tool.
negative.prompt: Who do you think will win the 2026 World Cup?

negative.description: Explaining what a bye is needs no bracket: the assistant explains in text and calls no tool.
negative.prompt: What does it mean when a team gets a bye in a tournament?

negative.description: Writing a team chant is unrelated to brackets: the assistant writes it directly and calls no tool.
negative.prompt: Write a fun team chant for our office volleyball team

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: single and double elimination brackets with standard seeding and correct byes, round robin schedules, Swiss pairings, timetables across courts, click-to-advance results with standings, printable PDF bracket and CSV schedule.

pl-PL.subtitle: Drabinki turniejowe i ligi
pl-PL.description: Twórz drabinki turniejowe w czacie, zapisuj wyniki kliknięciem zwycięzcy i drukuj je. Pojedyncza i podwójna eliminacja dla 2-128 graczy lub drużyn: standardowe rozstawienie (rozstawiony nr 1 gra z najniżej rozstawionym, numery 1 i 2 mogą spotkać się dopiero w finale), wolne losy dla najwyżej rozstawionych, gdy liczba uczestników nie jest potęgą dwójki, opcjonalny mecz o 3. miejsce, drabinka przegranych i wielki finał. Terminarz systemem każdy z każdym (metoda koła): każda para gra dokładnie raz, nikt nie gra dwa razy w rundzie, mecze u siebie i na wyjeździe są zrównoważone. System szwajcarski bez powtórek, gdy da się ich uniknąć. Harmonogram na kilku kortach lub boiskach z godzinami meczów. Tabela: punkty, bezpośrednie mecze, różnica punktów. PDF do druku w poziomie (czytelny do 64 graczy) i plik CSV.

de-DE.subtitle: Turnierbaum, Jeder gegen Jeden
de-DE.description: Erstelle Turnierbäume im Chat, trage Ergebnisse per Klick auf den Sieger ein und drucke sie aus. K.-o.-System und Doppel-K.-o. für 2 bis 128 Spieler oder Teams: Standard-Setzliste (Platz 1 gegen den niedrigsten Setzplatz, 1 und 2 können sich erst im Finale treffen), Freilose für die Topgesetzten, wenn die Teilnehmerzahl keine Zweierpotenz ist, optionales Spiel um Platz 3, Verliererrunde und großes Finale. Spielplan Jeder gegen Jeden nach der Kreismethode: jedes Paar spielt genau einmal, niemand spielt zweimal pro Runde, Heim- und Auswärtsspiele sind ausgeglichen. Schweizer System ohne vermeidbare Wiederholungspaarungen. Zeitplan über mehrere Plätze oder Tische mit Anstoßzeiten. Tabelle nach Punkten, direktem Vergleich und Differenz. Druckbares PDF im Querformat (lesbar bis 64 Spieler) und CSV-Spielplan.

es-ES.subtitle: Cuadros, liguillas y suizo
es-ES.description: Crea cuadros de torneo en el chat, registra resultados con un clic en el ganador e imprímelos. Eliminación simple y doble para 2 a 128 jugadores o equipos: cabezas de serie estándar (el 1 juega contra el último, el 1 y el 2 solo pueden cruzarse en la final), exenciones para los mejores cabezas de serie cuando el número de participantes no es potencia de dos, partido por el tercer puesto opcional, cuadro de perdedores y gran final. Calendario de liguilla (todos contra todos) con el método del círculo: cada pareja juega exactamente una vez, nadie juega dos veces por jornada y local y visitante están equilibrados. Sistema suizo sin repetir enfrentamientos cuando se puede evitar. Horario en varias pistas o campos con hora de cada partido. Clasificación por puntos, enfrentamiento directo y diferencia. PDF horizontal para imprimir (legible hasta 64 jugadores) y CSV.

fr-FR.subtitle: Tableaux, poules et suisse
fr-FR.description: Créez des tableaux de tournoi dans le chat, saisissez les résultats d'un clic sur le vainqueur et imprimez-les. Élimination directe et double élimination de 2 à 128 joueurs ou équipes : têtes de série standard (le 1 affronte la plus faible tête de série, le 1 et le 2 ne peuvent se rencontrer qu'en finale), exemptions pour les meilleures têtes de série quand le nombre d'inscrits n'est pas une puissance de deux, petite finale en option, tableau des perdants et grande finale. Calendrier de poule (chacun contre chacun) par la méthode du cercle : chaque paire se rencontre exactement une fois, personne ne joue deux fois dans un tour, domicile et extérieur équilibrés. Système suisse sans revanche lorsqu'on peut l'éviter. Horaires sur plusieurs terrains ou tables. Classement aux points, confrontation directe puis différence. PDF paysage imprimable (lisible jusqu'à 64 joueurs) et CSV.

ja-JP.subtitle: トーナメント表・総当たり・スイス式
ja-JP.description: チャットでトーナメント表を作り、勝者をクリックして結果を記録し、印刷できます。2〜128人またはチームのシングル・ダブルイリミネーションに対応。標準シード(第1シードは最下位シードと対戦し、第1・第2シードは決勝まで当たりません)、参加数が2の累乗でないときは上位シードに不戦勝を正しく配置、3位決定戦、敗者復活側のブラケットとグランドファイナルも作成。総当たり(サークル方式)は全ペアがちょうど1回対戦し、同じラウンドで2試合することはなく、ホームとアウェーも均等です。スイス式は避けられる限り再戦なし。コート数・試合時間・開始時刻から全試合の開始時刻とコートを割り当てます。順位表は勝ち点、直接対決、得失点差の順。横向きの印刷用PDF(64人まで読みやすい)とCSVを出力します。

pt-BR.subtitle: Chaves, pontos corridos, suíço
pt-BR.description: Monte chaves de torneio no chat, registre resultados clicando no vencedor e imprima. Eliminação simples e dupla para 2 a 128 jogadores ou equipes: cabeças de chave padrão (o 1 enfrenta o último, o 1 e o 2 só podem se cruzar na final), folgas (byes) para os melhores cabeças de chave quando o número de participantes não é potência de dois, disputa de terceiro lugar opcional, chave dos perdedores e grande final. Tabela de todos contra todos pelo método do círculo: cada dupla joga exatamente uma vez, ninguém joga duas vezes na mesma rodada e mando de campo equilibrado. Sistema suíço sem revanches quando é possível evitá-las. Horários em várias quadras ou campos. Classificação por pontos, confronto direto e saldo. PDF em paisagem para imprimir (legível até 64 jogadores) e CSV.
